name: semantic-bloom
title: Semantic bloom
author: Sanjay Kumar <https://github.com/luv-jeri>
description: A living wordmark whose particles wander, connect and gather into a liquid organism. Adapted from ThreeUI with Cojeev colors and motion controls.

props.name: text
props.description: Readable DOM wordmark. Whitespace and long text wrap naturally.

props.name: tone
props.description: Cojeev color presets. Inherits the surrounding light/dark theme.

props.name: opacity
props.description: Canvas opacity, 0–1; text always remains readable.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze decorative movement and pointer response.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Enable local pointer attraction without capturing scroll or clicks.

props.name: physics
props.description: Editable simulation forces, distances and density.

props.name: softness
props.description: Liquid edge blur, 0–20 CSS pixels. Default 12 (upstream).

props.name: connectionWidth
props.description: Connection stroke width, 0–8 CSS pixels. Default 4.

props.name: controlsRef
props.description: Imperative commands for native buttons or application events.

props.name: onWordActive
props.description: Optional decorative word proximity event; does not represent semantic understanding.
